title: eludite.terminal.close input
description: Close a terminal (its tab's close button; Kill Terminal): the shell is ended (SIGHUP, as closing a terminal window does; with `kill`, every process of the terminal's session is killed at once) and its tab closes. Closing a terminal whose shell runs a command needs `kill: true`, or it is refused naming the command; the window asks the person instead. For agents, class execute decided by the solution policy's `terminal.run`; with `kill`, class dangerous.

terminal.description: The terminal: its id from eludite.terminal.open or eludite.terminal.list (`term1`, `term2`, ...). Default: the active terminal of the Terminal window (the one last opened or selected).

kill.description: Kill the terminal's processes even while a command runs in it (default false).
